title: ExtractionTemplate
description: Template that drives native typed structured extraction. Steals Hyper-Extract's WHAT (output field schema) / HOW (guideline prompt) / identifiers (dedup keys) separation. See .agents/plans/2026-06-17-native-structured-extraction.md.

language.description: Natural language of the source/guideline (e.g. en).

type.description: Output structure. graph/temporal_graph -> PROV-O edges; model/set -> typed learning records. hypergraph/spatial/spatio-temporal are deliberately NOT supported (non-goal §7).

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this template extracts.

output.description: WHAT: the typed field schema for extracted entities and relations.

guideline.description: HOW: the extraction prompt that defines extraction quality.

identifiers.description: Dedup keys. relation_id uses the canonical '{from}|{relation}|{to}' form.

entity_id.description: Identifier expression for entity dedup, e.g. name.

relation_id.description: Identifier expression for relation dedup; canonical form '{from}|{relation}|{to}'.
